usedFor: Ringg AI handles conversations, and Google Drive files each one with “Create a new sheet or doc or slide”.

bestTemplate.name: “Conversation Ends” in Ringg AI, then “Create a new sheet or doc or slide” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: When a conversation ends, a fresh document gives you a place to keep the record.

watchOut: “Delete File” permanently removes a Drive file by ID or name, so never wire it to “Conversation Ends”.
